version_2_note: Supersedes the wording of version 2026-09-13.1's repeated_exit_labels dispositions only. The 15 m figure is relabelled an explicit QA heuristic, not evidence of real-world exit-structure identity; language claiming distance 'is consistent with two physically separate exit structures' is removed. Choa Chu Kang's repeated_exit_labels item is now closed as a processing decision (all points retained as published) while its semantic ambiguity is kept visible as a non-blocking quality flag rather than an open human-decision item. The six unusually_dispersed dispositions from version 2026-09-13.1 are unchanged and are not affected by this correction.
review_basis: Dispositions below use validated EPSG:3414 source-exit geometry and, where noted, exact official-name identity already established by the exact-normalized-name grouping rule. No source exit is ever merged, dropped or relabelled by a disposition; every distinct S005 point is retained exactly as published regardless of disposition.
distance_heuristic_disclaimer: The 15 m figure is a disclosed quality-assurance heuristic only. It decides whether a semantic-ambiguity flag needs to stay open for human attention; it is not authoritative evidence that same-labelled records more than 15 m apart are physically separate real-world exit structures, nor that records closer together are the same structure. No claim about real-world doorway-level identity is made either way for any repeated-label case.
